name: iOS Simulator
description: Adds Cindy's Host-owned embedded iOS Simulator workflow. WDA, H.264, HID, lifecycle, admission, ownership, recovery, and fallback remain Host-managed; external Xcode/Simulator/simctl is allowed only on an explicitly authorized fallback route with no Cindy-owned runtime active.
whenToUse: Prefer Cindy's embedded simulator. If Host reports unavailable/disabled or admission failure, confirms no Cindy-owned runtime or cleanup is active and runningInstanceCount=0, pass the original task and exact device identity to the Host-named Xcode/Simulator/simctl workflow; otherwise stop.
